OUR PROPOSAL — WHAT WE BUILT, MARKED IN RED

Direction chosen: Aligned replay in the existing sheet: recording and transcript on one clock, click a line to seek, turn markers on the scrubber; end-of-turn badges (Interrupted · Ignored · Error) on the agent line; Download and
Copy link. Degrades honestly when timestamps are missing.
Build. Backend must surface history timestamps and turns per session.
